name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The original task requires the agent to pick up the box again whenever it falls. None of the provided clauses express this requirement. Add a hard `RespondedExistence(box_fell, pickup)` or a hard `Response(box_fell, pickup)` clause (or equivalent), and keep the existing hard Existence(at_exit) and Response(at_exit, holding_box) clauses. The current machine never enforces re‑pickup after a fall, so the task is not correctly captured.

texts: The agent must eventually reach the exit.
When the agent reaches the exit, it must be holding the box.
Whenever the box falls, the agent must eventually be holding the box again.
